platformVerifiedFacts.claim: Android 17 reference platform includes a cgroup-v2 MemoryLimiter distinct from classic LMKD/global pressure.
Android 17 QPR2/API 37.2 provides app memory budgets/MemoryBudgetManager.
Android exposes historical exit records and API 35+ start records with version/permission limitations.
Cached-app/freezer and background-policy mechanisms can affect continuity independently of global memory pressure.
Perfetto supports trigger-based bounded capture with Android privilege constraints.
MGLRU/cgroup/DAMON mechanisms exist in Linux/AOSP reference stacks; existence does not prove safe target actuation.
Huawei documents multiple background-continuity policy controls whose paths vary by EMUI/HarmonyOS family.
